Anita (prod): Heads-up — enterprise pilot asked for tenant-scoped permissions so org admins can grant per-environment model access (prod vs staging) without separate teams. Thought: build a Role Composer in Console. Any quick takes?

Leo (eng-platform): +1. We should keep API-first. Two layers: Roles (named bundles) + Scopes (resource selectors). Roles map to sets of scopes. UI can compose them. Avoid creating a flat matrix for every resource.

Priya (design): Agree on composer. UX idea: a 'scope builder' that shows live preview: "What this role can do" — e.g., `invoke:model:my-namespace/*:predict` and `read:billing`. Slider for granularity (org/team/resource).

Samir (eng-security): Need audit and least-privilege by default. Also support service accounts (machine roles) with expiration. Can't allow role escalation via nested group inheritance unless explicitly allowed.

Anita (prod): Customers specifically asked: 1) restrict model invocation by route & token, 2) set quotas per role, 3) view per-role telemetry on console dashboards. How painful is adding quotas to role binding?

Leo (eng-platform): Quotas are doable but they live in policy layer. Proposal: RoleBindings = {principal, role, scope, quotaProfile?}. QuotaProfile can be optional pointer to quotas svc. This keeps roles reusable.

Priya (design): For quota UX, show typical quota presets (100k tokens/day, 10 req/s) and an "advanced" mode for custom limits. Show estimated cost impact inline.

Samir (eng-security): Must ensure quota enforcement path is on the runtime side (fast path) not just console. If we attach quotas per role, runtime needs to evaluate principal->roles fast. Suggest storing flattened allowed-claims in runtime cache.

Leo (eng-platform): Implementation sketch: API endpoints: `POST /roles`, `POST /scopes`, `POST /role_bindings`. Scope DSL minimal: `{resource_type}:{namespace}:{resource_pattern}:{actions}`. Example: `model:acme:recommendation-*:invoke,stream`

Anita (prod): Nice. One ask: for Dedicated customers we need tenant-scoped policies (no cross-tenant visibility). UX should default to "tenant-only" when creating roles in their workspace.

Priya (design): UX note: make it explicit when a role is sharable cross-tenant vs local. Use a pill/badge: "Workspace only" vs "Shareable (enterprise)" and require a confirmation modal for shareable roles.

Samir (eng-security): Also require ability to audit role history and snapshots for compliance. Wire export to syslog/S3.

Leo (eng-platform): Dev question: do we allow wildcard actions? e.g., `*` vs explicit `invoke,describe`. Prefer explicit but support `*` with warning.

Anita (prod): For rollout: start with Roles + RoleBindings + Scope DSL + read-only quota preview. Launch readonly in beta, then enable quota enforcement in next release.

Priya (design): I'll mock composer with scope presets and cost preview. Will post Figma link shortly.

Leo (eng-platform): I'll draft API proto and runtime cache plan. Will post in this thread when ready.
